messages:
Maya: Heads-up — PR #942 (migration guide: model v2) is stuck in docs-preview CI. It failed on linkcheck and vale. Can someone help triage?
CI Bot: docs-preview ⛔  failed for PR #942
-- linkcheck --
ERROR: docs/migration/v2.md: broken link to /api/v1/models -> 404
ERROR: docs/migration/v2.md: broken link to /sdk/python/old-snippet -> 404
-- vale --
docs/migration/v2.md: Heading 'Why this change matters' — Vale rule 'HeadingCapitalization' triggered
-- mdspell --
docs/migration/v2.md: 'enviroment' -> did you mean 'environment'?
Maya: Ugh. The two broken links are probably from renames in SDK docs; I missed updating them when I split the example snippets.
Samir: I can push a quick fix for the links. Which target should we point to? The new ref is /api/infra/models (new routing) and python snippet moved to /sdk/python/examples/model_migration.md
Ethan: For vale, the heading capitalization is strict — change to 'Why This Change Matters' (Title Case). Also there are a couple passive-voice spots flagged but minor.
Jules: I can review after the fixes — I have a merge window at 4:00 PM PT. If they get green before then I can approve and merge.
Maya: Thanks. Samir, could you open a small follow-up commit on the same branch and run the lint locally?
Samir: Yep — doing now. Running the usual commands: 
```
# from repo root
yarn install --frozen-lockfile
yarn docs:lint    # runs vale + mdspellyarn docs:preview  # runs linkcheck locally
```
Samir: Pushed commit 1f7b2 to fix links + typo + heading. @Jules please eyeball when you can.
CI Bot: New push detected — re-running docs-preview...
CI Bot: docs-preview ✅ all checks passed for PR #942
Jules: Reviewing now. Small nit: one example still uses `old_client.create_model(...)` — update to `models.create(...)` to match new SDK shape.
Maya: Good catch. Samir can you change that and squash?
Samir: Will do. Pushed 1f7b3 squashed.
Ethan: Once Jules approves, remember to use the 'merge when green' workflow and pick the 'squash and merge' option — we keep docs history tidy.
Jules: Approved :thumbsup: — merging now during the 4pm window.
Maya: Awesome — thanks all. If anyone hits similar linkcheck failures, remember the quick mapping: /api/v1/models -> /api/infra/models and python snippets moved under /sdk/python/examples. I'll add a note to the PR template. :spiral_notepad:
Ethan: Also filing a tiny Vale config tweak to relax that HeadingCapitalization rule on 'Why this change matters' headings specifically, linking to #eng-ml for discussion.
Maya: Cool. Closing thread. :tada:
